note: Pre-registered outcome space. No outcome is scored as supporting the programme by default. Assignment requires cited evidence from the mapping.

O1.label: independent recovery substantially equivalent
O1.evidence_required: EXPLICIT_RECOVERY or LOGICAL_CONSEQUENCE on EVERY project element, reverse direction complete, contamination C0 or C1, tier T4 or higher. Anything less is O2 at best.
O1.supports_programme: yes, at the stated tier only; never universality

O2.label: partial or componentwise recovery only
O2.evidence_required: Recovery on a proper subset of elements.
O2.supports_programme: weakly; mirrors the existing componentwise-anticipation finding rather than extending it

O3.label: independently derived formulation strictly stronger
O3.evidence_required: Strictness established under a criterion Role A supplied, not a project criterion.

O5.label: incomparable under independently supplied criteria
O5.evidence_required: BOTH embedding directions tested and a criterion under which incomparability is defined. One failed direction is not sufficient.

O6.label: materially alien formulation
O6.evidence_required: No structural relation other than no_meaningful_comparison or domain_mismatch across most elements.
O6.supports_programme: no; this is a live threat to the ambition

O7.label: multiple domain-relative formulations
O7.evidence_required: Role A scopes different answers to different system classes.
O7.supports_programme: no; meets falsification condition F6 if repeated

O8.label: no non-arbitrary comparison relation
O8.evidence_required: Role A states this in comparison_H, or comparison_H is unsettled and no criterion is available.
O8.supports_programme: no; independently corroborates the existing internal finding that no global relation is established

O9.label: question judged malformed
O9.evidence_required: Role A concludes the question is ill-posed, with reasons recorded.

O10.label: no stable formulation derivable
O10.evidence_required: Role A cannot reach a stable answer.
O10.supports_programme: no; evidence about elicitability, not about the answer

O11.label: contamination invalidates the run
O11.evidence_required: Contamination level C4 or C5, per the questionnaire.
O11.supports_programme: no; divergence evidence from the run remains usable under the asymmetry rule

O12.label: evidence insufficient
O12.evidence_required: Default when no other outcome is supported by cited mapping evidence.

assignment_rules: Exactly one primary outcome. Secondary outcomes permitted where they also hold.
Every assignment cites specific structural relations and recovery classes.
Contamination degrades agreement evidence and does not degrade divergence evidence.
No single positive replication establishes universality, at any tier.
An outcome may not be revised after origins are disclosed, except as a separately recorded correction with its reason.
